name: Production House Suite
promise: Move creative work through resumable jobs to verified deliverables.
completion_criteria: One Groundwire episode completes through ProductionJob with current audit and QC behavior preserved.
Formatter jobs, outputs, captions, manifests, retries, and failures link to the same job record.
Writers Room hands off versioned story state without becoming a second production runtime.
Adjacent pipelines join only after two shared mechanics prove reduced complexity.

waves.objective: Parse a real Groundwire episode script and project it into ProductionJob against fingerprinted production-house, Groundwire, and formatter donors.
waves.acceptance: The three donors have meaningful Git fingerprints, the episode script is hashed and parsed, and ProductionJob inputs match that digest. Outputs remain modeled; no audio runtime is invoked.
waves.runtime_followup: Render that episode through Groundwire and compare stems, captions, QC, failures, and recovery against this job.

waves.objective: Hash a real formatter play and advance it through ProductionJob without invoking the formatter runtime.
waves.acceptance: The job completes with a content-addressed output whose input digest matches the inspected play. The formatter is not invoked.
waves.runtime_followup: Invoke elevenlabs-screenplay-formatter on that play and compare output, failure, and recovery against this job.

waves.objective: Project a real Writers Room final as a ProductionJob input without invoking Writers Room or observing signoff.
waves.acceptance: The queued job input digest matches the inspected Writers Room final. Signoff is not observed and the runtime is not invoked.
waves.runtime_followup: Take the story state from the real Writers Room runtime through to a derived output with its job receipt.

waves.objective: Project a structurally distinct Groundwire episode plus production-house domain docs through ProductionJob.
waves.acceptance: The documentary variant completes with its full output set. Inputs are hashed donor artifacts; no media runtime is invoked.
waves.runtime_followup: Drive the multi-track and sound-design pipeline from a real documentary episode render.

waves.objective: Map real Writers Room pipeline status files into a canonical ProductionJob event stream.
waves.acceptance: At least two donor pipeline revisions unify into a single completed job event stream. Signoff and runtime consolidation are not performed.
waves.runtime_followup: Map real Writers Room revision history, including final room signoff, from that runtime.
